description: Live feed of pump.fun launches from the last 24h with creator context: who deployed each one, how many they launched before, whether they bought their own bonding curve. Poll with ?since= for only what is new. This history cannot be reconstructed afterwards. Facts and flags only, never advice. Free tier: 3 calls per hour per IP, shared with the website; unlimited access costs $0.030 per call over x402 at /v1/launches

limit.description: How many launches to return, newest first. Default 50.

only.description: Keep only launches carrying this trait. clean = no flags raised.

since.description: Unix timestamp; return only launches recorded after it. Pass next_since from your previous call to poll incrementally.

name: launches
